title: Robot Maze Project
description: Our final term project to graduate College was to create a robot that could find the solution to solve a maze. The robot runs through the maze once in order to find the end points and then a second time to solve the maze. A micro-controller was connected to a custom board that would read the optical sensors to find its location compared to the walls as well as the floor color. Black indicates the end of the maze. A message to the motor driver would power the DC motors in order to rotate the wheels a single step. Each step was measured by a shaft encoder (a hole in the gear where a laser can pass through per revolution). Steps where counted until the robot reaches a fork in the path. The first time the maze is ran, the robot would always turn right by turning both wheels in opposite directions like a tank. Along the way the robot keeps building an internal map and stores it in a secondary 8K memory card.
